description.zh:
HTTP请求内容类型。
非必填，如果填，请填写application/json;chatset=UTF-8
description.en: The content type of the HTTP request. This parameter is optional. If you specify this parameter, enter application/json;chatset=UTF-8.

description.zh: 快递公司编码。不指定快递公司时由系统进行分配。
description.en: The code of the courier company. If no courier company is specified, the system allocates a courier company.

description.zh: 外部渠道来源标识，不可包含下划线。接入时与系统约定取值。
description.en: The identifier of the external channel source. It cannot contain underscores.

description.zh: 接入方系统的订单编号。
description.en: The order number of the access system.

description.zh:
预估重量（单位：克）。

> 若您需要查询预估价格，该参数必传。
description.en:
The estimated weight. Unit: gram.

>  If you need to query the estimated price, this parameter is required.

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### [](#qps)QPS limits

You can call this operation up to 100 times per second per account. If the number of calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.
